newsitem.title: USA: Chevron removes some crews from U.S. Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Chevron removes some crews from U.S. Gulf.

text.p: Chevron Corp said Thursday that crews at its U.S. Gulf facilities south and west of Lafayette, Louisiana, were being evacuated ahead of Tropical Storm Danny but production was not affected.
"There are no shut-ins at this time. Production is normal," a company spokesman said, adding that the company's major fields can be operated by computer control from New Orleans.
He said non-essential personnel were being evacuated from facilities south and east of Lafayette, adding "As the storm track continues, we will move the evacuation line from west to east."

The spokesman said he did not anticipate any major impact from the storm, currently 115 miles southwest of New Orleans at latitude 28.6 north, longitude 90.9 west, moving northeast at five mph with sustained winds of 60 mph.
